name: generate_array
description: Repeat one element along a line, around a ring, or over a grid — the fix for parts you would otherwise collapse into one flat box. Universal: torn/shingled hems on cloaks and skirts, scales, feathers, overlapping armour plates, teeth in a jaw, spikes along a spine, rivets, fence posts, chain links, ribs, tassels. `mode:'linear'` needs start+end, `'radial'` needs center+radii (an ellipse in XZ, elements turned to face outward by default), `'grid'` needs start+end plus counts (or count). `anchor` decides how each element sits on its point: 'center' (default), 'top' (element HANGS from the point — use for fringes), 'bottom' (stands on it — spikes), 'min'. `jitter` breaks the machine-regular look, `size_decay` grows/shrinks elements along the run (per-step delta in units, negative to taper), `rotation_range` {min,max} gives each element its own tilt, and `depth_stagger` alternates neighbours in depth so overlapping rows CANNOT z-fight — always pass 0.05-0.2 for shingled rows. `seed` makes the randomness repeatable. The result reports `z_fight_pairs`: elements whose faces ended up on the same plane anyway (a row where each element overlaps two others still lines up), with the fix to apply — act on it rather than leaving it for check_model.

align_to_center.description: Radial: turn each element so its FRONT face points away from the centre (default true in radial mode).

anchor.description: Where the element sits relative to its point (default 'center'). Also the rotation pivot.

arc_degrees.description: Radial: how much of the circle to cover (default 360; use 180 for a half ring of teeth).

count.description: How many elements (linear/radial; in grid mode it caps the total).

counts.description: Grid: elements per axis [nx, ny, nz]. Omit to derive a near-square layout from `count`.

depth_axis.description: Which axis depth_stagger pushes along (default 'auto': perpendicular to a linear run, outward for a radial one).

depth_stagger.description: Alternating offset along the depth axis (default 0). ANTI Z-FIGHTING: pass 0.05-0.2 whenever elements overlap.

distribution.description: 'span' (default): the first and last element land exactly on start/end. 'cells': elements are evenly tiled with none hanging off the ends — what a continuous fringe or shingle row wants.

element_size.description: Size of one element [width, height, depth] in units.

end.description: Linear: last point. Grid: the opposite corner.

jitter.description: Random offset range per axis [jx,jy,jz] — 0.1-0.4 makes a row look hand-made instead of stamped.

max_cubes.description: Safety cap on how many cubes this call may create (default 1500).

name_prefix.description: Name prefix; elements are <prefix>_1..N (default 'element'). detail_cubes colour rules match on this.

parent.description: uuid or name of the bone to build into.

radii.description: Radial: [radius_x, radius_z] — different values give an ellipse.

rotation.description: Base rotation in degrees applied to every element.

rotation_range.description: Random rotation per element, e.g. {min:[-8,-4,-8], max:[8,4,8]}. Added on top of `rotation`.

seed.description: Seed for jitter/rotation randomness — same seed, same result.

side.description: The model's own side, enforced against the geometry.

size_decay.description: Per-step size change [dw,dh,dd] in units, added cumulatively. Negative tapers the run (teeth, spikes, a narrowing fringe).

start.description: Linear: first point. Grid: one corner of the area.

start_degrees.description: Radial: angle of the first element, 0 = +X (default 0).
